Ava: Popcorn vs tea one-liner bounty! Drop your best one-liner. Winner gets the last cookie in the jar. :cookie:
Ben: I don't negotiate with snack terrorists. :sunglasses:
Cara: @Ava challenge accepted — 'My code runs faster after coffee because it knows better.'
Dmitri: Microwave etiquette reminder: if you nuke fish, write a note. Also labeling to avoid mystery smell :fish:
Eli: :100: good call — also please don't reheat kale soup at 6pm, office firewall already overloaded.
Ava: :raised_hands: Love them. Quick poll: popcorn or tea? React with :popcorn: or :tea:
Cara: popcorn :popcorn: (also will bribe with stickers)
Ben: tea :tea: (but will take the cookie regardless)
OfficeBot: Reminder: Free snacks restocked in the kitchen at 10:30am. :bell:
Dmitri: kudos to @Janice for restocking the oat milk :sparkles:
Eli: One-liner submission: 'My todo list is called "suggestions".'
Ava: Winner so far: @Eli +1 cookie. Anyone want to trade sticker for cookie? :wink:
Ben: I'll trade two stickers. But only holographic ones.
Cara: Microwave rulebook (excerpt):
```
No fish
Clean within 2 mins
Label experiments
Keep lid on
```
Dmitri: :laughing: add 'no cilantro experiments'
Janice: omg thanks for the shoutout! Cookies are on me if you return the jar label :heart:

Ava: Okay vote tally: popcorn 1, tea 1, cookie majority (unofficial). Cookie claimant: @Eli — collect at snack shrine. :cookie: :trophy:
